verses.en: When the heaven is cleft asunder
When the seas are poured forth
A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind

verses.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
verses.en: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful
Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee

verses.ar: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةࣲ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.en: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee
Nay, but ye deny the Judgment
Lo! there are above you guardians
Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight
And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell
They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment
And will not be absent thence
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

verses.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسࣱ لِّنَفۡسࣲ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لِّلَّهِ
verses.en: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's
